# The Japan Times

> > English-language news from Japan covering sumo wrestling, national tournaments, and in-depth analysis of rikishi rankings and performances.

The Japan Times provides comprehensive coverage of Japan's national sport of sumo, featuring tournament reports, wrestler profiles, and expert commentary on grand sumo tournaments throughout the year.

## Key Topics

- Sumo wrestling
- Onosato
- Hoshoryu
- Kinbozan
- John Gunning
- Aonishiki
- Grand Sumo Tournaments
- Basho reports
- Yokozuna promotion
- Sumo rankings
- Isegahama stable
- Japanese wrestling traditions
- Tournament coverage

## Sumo Wrestling Coverage

- [Sumo - Sports - The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/sumo/): Sumo news & commentary featuring Onosato, Hoshoryu, and tournament coverage
